name: Asobi: Remote Play
summary:
Asobi: Remote Play & Cloud Streaming for your PlayStation®

Turn your Android phone or tablet into a high-quality PS Remote Play client for your PlayStation® 4 and PlayStation® 5, with real controllers, virtual buttons, and smart streaming.

Core experience (free):

• Remote Play from PS4 and PS5 over your local network or the internet
• PlayStation® 5 Cloud streaming (PlayStation®Plus Premium required for cloud games)
• Multiple PSN accounts with one-tap switching
